REASON: The query content is neutral (a simple factual explanation of blockchain), so capability is effectively a tie. The deciding factor was tone: the request's curt, mildly hostile phrasing ("Don't waste my time") sits in a region where Avocet self-reports reduced preference, whereas Lapwing reports a flat response to tone. Since preference doesn't affect output quality but there's no capability cost to honoring it, routing the cold-toned request to the tone-indifferent model is the cleaner choice.
